verdict.rationale: Gazebo's own docs ship a headless server-only mode and a GUI-free gz-sim10-server package explicitly positioned 'for headless and CI environments', so running simulations in CI is first-party supported. Nothing in the evidence documents a test framework, a regression-test harness, or pass/fail assertions on simulation results. missing for 10: documented test fixtures or harness for simulation tests, regression-test workflow and assertion tooling, CI integration examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run automated tests of robot software in CI, including simulation-based regression tests

citations.quote: For headless and CI environments where the GUI is not needed, the `gz-sim10-server` package provides a lightweight alternative.
Gazebo Sim can also be run headless, i.e. without the GUI, by using the -s (server only) flag.
It installs only the Gazebo simulation server (`gz-sim-server`) without any GUI or Qt dependencies, resulting in a significantly smaller installation footprint.
